job_dir.ask: Folder the Data Collector job import takes job files from
job_dir.help: The folder the lab's Operator Interface job list, batch script or Universal Automation Interface client watches (see references/xrdml_files.md). Must exist and be writable by the account running mhp on the Data Collector PC.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the .xrdml files of the queued scans are written
results_dir.help: The result folder of the measurement program; the package waits for <sample_id>_<token>.xrdml there.

programs_dir.ask: Data Collector folder holding the .xrdmp measurement programs

changer_positions.ask: Number of positions on the sample changer (6 or 67 on an Aeris)

changer_s.ask: Seconds a changer cycle takes (for progress and the wait)

max_points.ask: Most data points a queued scan may have

max_scan_hours.ask: Longest scan an agent may queue (hours)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the results folder

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for a result before the job fails (seconds)
